description: Na₃VCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and faces with two equivalent VO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.48 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.64 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 73-78°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.71 Å. V is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted VO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 73-78°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.33 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.32 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent VO₆ octahedra and corners with six NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-69°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one V, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one V, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to two Na, one V, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one V, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one V, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one V, and one P atom.
